C-SUPERSEDE-RECORD.Summary: Make ngrace supersede fold any open epoch before it archives, so the discarded bundle keeps its run record, and document that the verb discards governance, never code. No new event kind. No new src file.
C-SUPERSEDE-RECORD.Problem:
ngrace supersede writes superseded, names the replacement, and renames the bundle into archive/. It does not fold. Measured 2026-09-01 on this tree:
C-SUPERSEDE-VERB (five tasks executed): archive has run-ledger.xml with 3 approve Decisions, 0 Epoch elements, 0 attempts; run/ is absent; status epochCount=0. C-LINT-PHASE-HONESTY (five tasks, same class of event): Epoch-1, 10 attempts (4 fail, 6 pass), 4 named signatures; run/ present and empty after fold; epochCount=1. The only difference is that the second had cursor advance --kind terminal and cursor fold run by hand first. src/grace-supersede.ts contains no reference to fold, Epoch, or run/.
Probe of HEAD (temp project, writeMinimalNgraceProject): open an epoch with no terminal, then supersede. Exit 0. Archive holds run/1-T-001-opened.xml and no run-ledger.xml. Rename preserves loose files; it does not write an Epoch. The measuring instrument (status.epochCount, ledger attempts) therefore prices the discard at zero. That is F128 / F134.1 / F134.2.
Fold does not no-op on a never-executed bundle. cursor fold --change C-PHASE-RULE-PIN prints "No loose run/ events to fold for C-PHASE-RULE-PIN." and exits 1 (stderr; stdout empty). The same refuse hits C-SUPERSEDE-VERB (ledger with Decisions, 0 Epochs, no loose events). Calling foldEpoch unconditionally from supersede would refuse the C-PHASE-RULE-PIN shape.
Fold's unterminated-range check is not silent. Probe: opened event, no terminal, cursor fold exits 1, stderr "unterminated range for w0", no ledger written, loose files remain. The brief's "exit 0, silently" is false at this HEAD. Grammar also requires a terminal inside every live allocation (src/artifact/grammar.ts ledger.range-unterminated). So a discarded open epoch cannot fold unless a terminal event sits in range.
Nothing in the verb description, README CLI row, or skills states that supersede discards governance and never code. F127's recorded close is the precedent: T-001-T-007 complete, in scope, and green; nothing needs reverting. The replacement carries implementation forward. A reader may assume the opposite; that difference is the whole cost model.
RM-PILOT-APPROVAL review.md:80 calls an amendment count in the ledger "the measuring instrument". An archive that prices discarded executions at zero cannot support that decision. This bundle is the first of the three instrument bundles F134.1 named (discard, then amendment counter, then effort). The latter two stay out.

Goals.Goal: supersedeChangeBundle folds any open epoch into run-ledger.xml before the status write and rename, so an abandoned execution archives with its Epoch, attempts, and signatures intact without the operator running terminal and fold by hand.
A bundle that never executed (C-PHASE-RULE-PIN shape: no loose run/ events) still supersedes. Fold is skipped, not invoked.

Document on the verb itself and on the README.md CLI Overview row that supersede discards the governance record, never the code, and that it folds first. Teach the same two facts where agents are told to run the verb (ngrace-plan approved_plan_immutability and ngrace-execute preflight).

Constraints.Constraint: Ceremony tier T2 (cross-cutting: M-GATES write surface, M-CLI command description, M-CURSOR fold/advance, M-SKILLS teaching). Gates still run.

Layer: put fold inside supersedeChangeBundle (src/gates/ledger.ts:1270), before the superseded status write and renameSync. Only two callers exist: src/grace-supersede.ts:89 (CLI) and src/grace-supersede.test.ts:327,334 (EXDEV injection). The CLI already only validates then delegates. ledger.ts:65 already imports resolveChangeBundle from ../grace-cursor; grace-cursor.ts imports nothing from gates/. Calling foldEpoch and advanceCursor from ledger.ts follows that existing edge. Do not put the fold only in the CLI handler: that is F133's wrong-layer miss, and the EXDEV test would then exercise a subset of the verb. Do not add a new src/*.ts file. C-SUPERSEDE-VERB died that way. Do not add a new export unless MAP_MODE EXPORTS requires it; a private helper inside ledger.ts is enough.

Sequence inside supersedeChangeBundle, after the existing validation and before any spec/plan byte write: (1) list loose run/ events for the active bundle; (2) if none, skip fold; (3) if loose events exist and no kind=terminal sits inside the effective covering allocation, advanceCursor with kind=terminal on the last loose event's task; (4) foldEpoch; (5) existing status write, Replacement insert, rename. If step 3 or 4 throws, write nothing superseded and leave the bundle under active/. Stdout of the CLI stays the archive-relative path; do not add fold chatter.

Terminal-on-abandon is a range close, not a completion judgment. kind=terminal remains the covering allocation close that fold and grammar both require (src/grace-cursor.ts:2556-2559, src/artifact/grammar.ts:1119-1127). The operator judgment that the work is abandoned is status= superseded plus the Replacement pointer. Auto-emitting terminal from supersede is the binary satisfying fold's precondition from that judgment. It is honest because F134.2 measured the consumers: cursor show on C-LINT-PHASE-HONESTY after the hand terminal+fold+supersede reports State: complete (cursor lifecycle) and Complete: n/a (work-completion); status reports specStatus=superseded, planStatus=superseded, epochCount=1, derivedStates=[]. No surface claims the abandoned work completed. Do not add a discarded kind. Do not change KNOWN_EVENT_KINDS (pinned at 9 in src/grace-cursor.test.ts:3199). Do not relax fold's unterminated check on the general cursor fold path. Do not change State: complete naming (F134.2 recorded that as a legibility nit, not this bundle).

Crash window: fold-then-rename means an EXDEV after a successful fold leaves the bundle under active/ with a closed epoch and no loose events. The existing spec/plan rollback still applies. Re-invoking supersede takes the no-loose-events skip and retries the write+rename. The EXDEV test must keep refusing after rollback; it may now observe a folded ledger under active/.

Both skill edits state the two facts: the verb folds any open epoch (no-op when none exists), and it discards governance, never code. Do not restate the command inventory in ngrace-cli; that skill defers inventory to the README table bound to listLiveInvocations.

README.md CLI Overview row is in scope. examples/ is not. That skeleton is not this bundle. A criterion that demanded teaching-surface green would be F127: unsatisfiable while this spec also forbids filling that sibling.

AcceptanceCriteria.AC-FOLD-BEFORE-ARCHIVE: On a throwaway project, open an epoch (advanceCursor openEpoch, no terminal), run ngrace supersede --change C-OLD --replacement C-NEW. Exit 0. The archived C-OLD has a run-ledger.xml Epoch containing the opened event, a kind=terminal event, and no foldable loose events under run/. status for that change reports epochCount greater than 0. HEAD today archives the opened file and no ledger; that probe must go red first, then green.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-NO-EPOCH-NOOP: supersede of a spec-only active bundle with no run/ directory (C-PHASE-RULE-PIN shape) exits 0 and archives. It must not invoke foldEpoch in a way that surfaces "No loose run/ events to fold" (that CLI currently exits 1). Existing spec-only supersede tests stay green.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-NO-NEW-KIND: KNOWN_EVENT_KINDS remains the nine kinds opened, progress, resume, attempt, verification-unavailable, command-run, pause, terminal, escalation. bun test src/grace-cursor.test.ts keeps the length-9 pin green. No discarded kind anywhere.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-GOVERNANCE-NOT-CODE: src/grace-supersede.ts meta.description and the README.md CLI Overview description cell for ngrace supersede both state that the verb folds any open epoch and that it discards governance, never code. ngrace-plan approved_plan_immutability and ngrace-execute preflight state the same two facts. ngrace supersede --help prints the new description. Packaged mirrors stay byte-identical to canonical.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-NO-NEW-FILE: git status after the change shows no new file under src/*.ts. scripts/release-check.ts PACK_ALLOWED_EXACT is not grown by a new exact member.

The skill-contract pinned phrases listed in Constraints still appear. The token-accounting pin matches the post-edit skillTextLines() measure, not the pre-edit 58400.

Assumptions.Assumption: F134.2's consumer measurement still holds after auto-emitting terminal: Complete stays a target-assertions field, not a function of kind=terminal, so a superseded folded bundle does not start claiming the work completed.

listLooseEvents empty is the right skip predicate. A bundle with only unparseable run/ orphans (C-TOKEN-INTEGRITY NaN shape) has no foldable events and should skip the same way; this bundle does not add orphan recovery to supersede.
